title: Northwest Straits Marine Conservation Initiative Reauthorization Act of 2025
official_title: To reauthorize the Northwest Straits Marine Conservation Initiative Act to promote the protection of the resources of the Northwest Straits, and for other purposes.
likelihoodReason: Introduced by Rep. Larsen (D-WA) with 6 cosponsors; passed the House and was placed on the Senate Legislative Calendar. A modest, regionally focused conservation reauthorization tends to clear the Senate when floor time allows.

votes.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended

summary: Renews and updates a federal program that supports local efforts to protect and restore the marine waters of the Northwest Straits in Washington's Puget Sound.
brief: Reauthorizes the Northwest Straits Marine Conservation Initiative through fiscal year 2031 at $10M per year.

top_lines.headline: Northwest Straits Program
subs: Reauthorizes the Northwest Straits Marine Conservation Initiative
Authority to carry out the title sunsets 7 years after enactment
Supports local marine protection in Puget Sound

top_lines.headline: Commission Structure

items.main: Names the Act the “Northwest Straits Marine Conservation Initiative Reauthorization Act of 2025”.
items.detail: Short-title section — citation name only; no substantive effect.

sections.label: Section 2 — Reauthorization of Northwest Straits Marine Conservation Initiative Act

items.main: Reauthorizes and rewrites the Northwest Straits Marine Conservation Initiative (title IV of Public Law 105-384).
items.detail: It rewrites the program's definitions and the 14-member Advisory Commission (county marine resources committee appointees, two tribal representatives, and Washington gubernatorial appointees), whose goal is to protect and restore the marine waters, habitats, and species of the Northwest Straits region of Puget Sound. The Commission advises, collects data, and reports annually against benchmarks but has no authority to issue regulations. The authority to carry out the title terminates 7 years after the date of enactment.

gaps: The bill authorizes $10M a year but the actual funding depends on later appropriations.
It reauthorizes an advisory commission that cannot itself implement or enforce any protections.

featured_quotes.name: Mr. Westerman
featured_quotes.text: I support this bill to reauthorize the Northwest Straits Advisory Commission. I commend my colleague, the gentleman from the State of Washington (Mr. Larsen), not only for his work on this bill but for his leadership to pass the successful highway transportation reauthorization bill recently. Again, I support the legislation.

featured_quotes.name: Mr. Larsen
featured_quotes.text: The Northwest Straits Marine Conservation Initiative started as a bipartisan, homegrown idea. Thanks to the foresight and hard work of Democratic Senator Patty Murray and my predecessor here in the U.S. House of Representatives, former Representative Jack Metcalf, and local stakeholders, Congress created the Northwest Straits Marine Conservation Commission in 1998. The commission works with seven county-based marine resources committees, or MRCs, in northwest Puget Sound.

modified: Northwest Straits Marine Conservation Initiative (title IV of Public Law 105-384) reauthorized with a rewritten commission structure and duties, and authority to carry out the title terminating 7 years after enactment

added: New sunset: authority to carry out the title terminates 7 years after enactment
removed: Drops the entire funding section — including the authorization of $10,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2026 through 2031 and "such sums as may be necessary" for FY2032 and after
Removes the assistance provisions, including funding the Commission through a contract with the Director of the Padilla Bay National Estuarine Research Reserve subject to the Governor's objection
Removes the section 403 "Findings" (declines in marine health, climate-change threats, NOAA partnership history)
Removes the Commission's authority to solicit and accept gifts, devises, and bequests
